sentences.text: The present application has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioners for an early hearing.
As the matter is already fixed for 08.07.2024, there is no ground for early hearing.
In view of the above, the present application stands dimissed.

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Article 226 Constitution of India for quashing of FIR No. 575/2021 dated 23.07.2021 under Section 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Uttam Nagar, New Delhi and the proceedings emanating there from.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/06/2024 at 22:29:49
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there are no allegations against the petitioner in the FIR.
However, it is submitted that the investigating officer has filed the charge-sheet against the petitioners wrongly and illegally.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Petitioner No.1 is the mother-in-law of the complainant, Petitioner No.2 is the brother-in-law of the complainant and Petitioner No.3 is the maternal aunt of the complainant.

sentences.text: Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State has accepted the notice and seeks time to file the report.
Let the report be filed.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the matter is fixed for 04.06.2024 before the Ld.
Trial Court and the petitioner may be exempted from the personal appearance before the Ld. Trial Court.
Let petitioners appear through Video Conferencing before the Ld. Trial Court.
List the matter before the Roster Bench on 08.07.2024 i.e., the date already fixed.
DINESH KUMAR SHARMA, J (VACATION JUDGE) JUNE 3, 2024/AR..
